routeSelectionNote: This packet is built for exactly one statutory route: Non-conviction arrest-information expungement under HRS § 831-3.2 (Haw. Rev. Stat. § 831-3.2). The form's other paragraph — the first-time drug/property offender and DUI-under-21 CONVICTION branch — is declared not applicable on this route and carries a named route condition. The form's own route mark is an INITIAL CELL beside a sworn paragraph, and this build never writes an applicant's initials; the route the packet proceeds under is stated here, in participant-instructions.md and in filing-instructions.md, and the participant initials the paragraph themselves.
geometrySource: every write and refusal area is measured out of the bound source bytes at build time; no coordinate in the builder is authored
